title: Light bending and observational bounds in dyonic Kalb-Ramond gravity
summary: We investigate the weak and strong gravitational lensing of a dyonic black hole in Kalb-Ramond gravity. After fixing the asymptotic normalization, we distinguish the effective charge governing the local null trajectories from the global angular identification associated with Lorentz-symmetry breaking. In the weak-deflection regime, we evaluate the Gaussian curvature explicitly and apply the Gauss-Bonnet theorem with a perturbed ray boundary, recovering the complete second order mass contribution.
